This is your new role The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for applying quality tools, methods, and judgement to support manufacturing operations and ensure product and process compliance. The role operates with increasing independence and responsibility, progressing from execution of defined quality activities to ownership of complex investigations, decision-ready analysis, and technical leadership within an area of project. Support and drive manufacturing quality activities within assigned areas or processes. Apply quality tools and methodologies (e.g. SPC, MSA, RCA, 8D) to investigate non-conformance and deviations. Analyse quality and process data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. Support and participate in audits, reviews, and change activities. Review and support risk assessments, containment actions, and corrective actions. Ensure compliance with defined quality procedures, standards, and safety requirements. Support customer, assembly, and internal quality complaints within assigned scope. Participate in / lead MRBs and support disposition of non-conforming material. Support change control activities (QCM) by reviewing risk, data, and quality impact. Liaise with BG, Back End and Front End teams to ensure quality alignment. Support preparation of quality data, responses, and correspondence for internal and external stakeholders. This is you Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, manufacturing, science or quality. Minimum 3 years of technical quality experience in semiconductors, electronics or high demanding industry depending on educational credentials Experience in (automotive) manufacturing processes Practical application of quality tools and problem-solving methods (SPC, 8D, 6 Sigma, Shainin, etc.) Proficient use of data analysis and reporting tools Clear written and verbal communicator in English and German, suitable for technical and cross-functional audiences Good planning and organisational skills (Desirable) Qualified Internal Auditor (VDA 6.3 / IATF 16949) We offer This is what Nexperia offers Flexible working hours and the possibility of overtime reduction to maintain Work-Life-Balance Unlimited employment contract with a competitive salary and supplementary voluntary employee benefits A wide variety of training courses and career development options Numerous further benefits, such as retirement provisions, travel allowance for the HVV public transport ticket, business bike, company events, sports and leisure activities, employee discounts and even more Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated.
